Source introduction:
Abdul El-Sayed (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Michigan. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
El-Sayed completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.

Which relationship does the source establish? A list explicitly framed as endorsements can report an endorsement. A named voter guide/Sway voting group is a recommendation, not automatically a formal endorsement. Keep awards/designations distinct; do not turn generic mention, donations, candidate opponents, or lists of candidates this person endorsed into endorsements OF this candidate. The generic boilerplate combines endorsements and recommendations: use the specific entry and its category. Do not rely on URL filenames alone. Hold ambiguous cases.

criteria.endorsed: The source reports this named entity endorsing this candidate
criteria.recommended: The source reports a voter-guide or recommendation relationship
criteria.distinction: An award, badge or program distinction
criteria.unrelated: Mention, navigation, donor, opponent or reverse endorsement
